# DSH Remote Android

> Android phone client for DSH Remote Host. Pair to DeepSeek Harness on the same LAN.

This repository is the Android application, not a DSH plugin.

- Releases / APK: https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-android/releases
- Debug package id: `dev.dshremote.gate0c`
- Host plugin (install first): https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-host
  `dsh plugin --profile web add @w2112515/dsh-remote-host`
  Then Settings → Mobile access on the PC.
- A marketplace pack cannot install this APK.

The phone can list Host sessions, chat, create a workspace-bound session, approve tools, and review artifacts. Absolute paths stay on the Host. Same Wi-Fi only. Windows x64 is the reviewed Host platform.

Full facts: https://github.com/w2112515/dsh-remote-host/blob/main/llms.txt
